name: calcite: Xiao 2011 charges + Li 2021 LJ (Xiao-based)
note: The calcite slab is held rigid (frozen), so only its nonbonded parameters (charge, epsilon, sigma) act on the fluid. Intra-calcite terms do not affect the results.

Charges: Ca +1.668, C +0.999, O -0.889 (neutral CO3 + Ca). These are the Xiao, Edwards & Grater force field: J. Phys. Chem. C 115 (2011) 20067. The Ca charge +1.668 is confirmed in Xiao, Edwards & Grater, Biophys. J. 102 (2012) 3 Suppl. 1 (abstract). The C and O values come from a secondary source; they are consistent with charge neutrality.

LJ (pure, for mixing with other species): Li, Vovusha, Sharma, Singh & Schwingenschlogl, Adv. Theory Simul. 4 (2021) 2100226, Table 1, 'atomwise' C12/C6 for Ca, Cm, Om, converted with sigma = (C12/C6)^(1/6) and epsilon = C6^2/(4 C12). The C12/C6 exponents in the extracted text were checked against the AMBER CT and HC entries of the same table, which give the known AMBER values (sigma 3.400 / 2.650 A, epsilon 0.458 / 0.0657 kJ/mol).

Not yet confirmed: that reference [29] of Li et al. (the source of their calcite LJ) is Xiao et al. 2011. Calcite-water cross terms here use Lorentz-Berthelot mixing, not Xiao's fitted CaCO3-water cross terms.
